Assuming we'd like to move forward with scheduling mainnet, here are some potential slot/epoch/UTC combos:

`192512    6160384    4/6/2023, 2:37:11 AM`
`194048    6209536    4/12/2023, 10:27:35 PM`
`195584    6258688    4/19/2023, 6:17:59 PM`
If there's time, can @potuz and I briefly discuss: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/388 ?

Time permitting, I would like to discuss [EIP-6601](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-6601-evm-modular-arithmetic-extensions-evmmax/13168) and [EIP-6690](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-6690-evm-modular-arithmetic-extensions-evmmax-decoupled-from-eof/13322).

EIP 6601 supersedes EIP-5843.  EIP-6690 is a modified version of EIP-6601 which removes EOF as a dependency.

Since eip-1153 is on the agenda as a propsed EIP, I just wanted to give a concise update on it’s current state:

- It has been implemented, tested, & merged in [geth](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/26003), [nethermind](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/4126), [besu](https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pull/4118), and [ethereumjs](https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/1860).
- It has been partially implemented in [erigon](https://github.com/ledgerwatch/erigon/pull/6133), with some minor work left and additional testing.
- Tests have been merged in [ethereum/tests](https://github.com/ethereum/tests/pull/1196) and have been run against geth, nethermind, besu, and ethereumjs.
- An implementation for [inline assembly](https://github.com/ethereum/solidity/pull/13285) in solidity has been built and tested with some Uniswap related prototypes.

> Assuming we'd like to move forward with scheduling mainnet, here are some potential slot/epoch/UTC combos:
> 
> `192512 6160384 4/6/2023, 2:37:11 AM` `194048 6209536 4/12/2023, 10:27:35 PM` `195584 6258688 4/19/2023, 6:17:59 PM`

The only concern I have is i'm not around on the 6th April, but if it works for everyone else the rest of the team can probably deal with anything that arises...  Personally I'd love to see it go live and not just have to hope it worked :)

If time permits, we'd like to share the [Exploring Ethereum’s Client Ecosystem report](https://medium.com/ethereum-cat-herders/exploring-ethereums-client-ecosystem-afc9affa84dd) based on the Client Diversity survey.
